validation: Same exact 304 suite paths and 2287 case-name multiset; zero failures, errors or skips; six workers; source trees and revision fixed.
metric: Seconds from workflow created_at to last completed_at including producer, wait, download and result. Warm reuse excludes previously completed producer latency, whose job cost is retained separately.
eligibility: All completed runs retained; descriptive no-queue groups require maximum non-skipped job queue <=15 seconds. Checkout variation remains included. User-directed early stopping reduces samples; queued runs are not replaced.
stopping_rule: Originally five per arm; user requested fewer tests after the first warm samples. Closed with three independent, three full overlap, three imports overlap, two full reuse and three imports reuse runs. No confirmatory significance claims after adaptive stopping.
